title: NOAA: before the industrial revolution, CO2 was 280 ppm or less
summary: NOAA Climate.gov says that before the Industrial Revolution, in the mid-1700s, atmospheric CO2 was 280 ppm or less.
body: NOAA Climate.gov's atmospheric carbon dioxide article says that before the Industrial Revolution started in the mid-1700s, atmospheric carbon dioxide was 280 parts per million or less. The 2024 global annual average is a different sentence and is already stored. This card is the pre-industrial figure the article states.
